---
name: Issue
about: Report a bug, suggest an improvement, or raise a documentation issue.
---

<!-- Adapt this template to the project. When opening an issue, keep the relevant
sections and remove the rest. A short, clear report is enough for a small issue. -->

## Summary

Describe the problem or improvement and who it affects. Say whether this is a bug, feature request, or documentation issue.

## Current and desired behavior

What happens now, and what should happen instead? For a feature request, describe the use case and desired outcome.

## Reproduction (for bugs)

Provide the smallest useful example and steps to reproduce. Include relevant error messages or screenshots if they help. If the issue is intermittent, describe when you have observed it.

## Environment (when relevant)

Include the SettingsKit version or commit, Apple OS/platform, Xcode version, and Swift version. Say whether it also occurs in the latest release, if checked.

## Proposed approach (optional)

Share a possible solution, alternatives, or workarounds. You do not need to implement a fix to open an issue.

## Additional context (optional)

Link related issues or explain constraints that affect the solution.
